title: Modular A/V: Plates theme
description: A fighter's harness for the Modular A/V dock. Each camera sits in a plate of dark, worn steel, laced round with a cord in its player's colour, on mail over blue cloth. A voice polishes the plate, a muted plate goes dull, and one out of the call rusts and loses its cord. The blade of a knife under your own name shines as far as your voice goes. The header and the voice panel are larger plates, the buttons small hammered ones, and a mace, gauntlets or a buckler hang where there is room.

facts.label: Who picks it
facts.value: The GM, as the table's look, or each player
